verification_note: Karnataka is a fully segregated code path with its own labour, professional tax and welfare-fund instruments and its own filing portals.

instruments.title: Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishments Act, 1961
instruments.authority: Department of Labour, Government of Karnataka

obligations.summary: Commercial establishments in the state register under the Karnataka Act and its rules.
Karnataka has historically issued conditional exemptions for IT/ITES establishments; the current notification and its conditions must be read before relying on any exemption.

instruments.title: Karnataka Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 1976
instruments.authority: Commercial Taxes Department, Government of Karnataka

obligations.summary: Karnataka professional tax registration and remittance follow the state's own notification.
Annual welfare fund contribution is payable to the Karnataka board.

state_escalation_triggers: Relying on an IT/ITES exemption notification without confirming it is currently in force and that the conditions attached to it are met.
